title: Jardines de las Lomas
location: Lomas de Pozuelo, Río Real, Marbella East
shortDescription: A beautifully maintained townhouse in a quiet community of only 18 homes — move-in ready, with a private terrace, mountain views, and a sun-filled southwest orientation.
description:
Exclusively for sale in the peaceful area of Lomas del Pozuelo, Río Real — this townhouse offers the perfect balance between living in nature and urban convenience. Located just 4km from downtown Marbella and around 2km from the beaches and the Senda Litoral coastal path.

Urbanización Jardines de Las Lomas is a small residential complex of only 18 townhouses, standing out for its mature communal gardens and quiet, private community pool. Being a family-friendly complex where many owners live permanently, there is a genuine sense of community.

The property is arranged over three floors. The entrance level has two bedrooms with fitted wardrobes, French balconies, and a southwest orientation with beautiful mountain and sunset views — plus a recently renovated bathroom with walk-in shower and electric towel rail.

The lower ground floor features a spacious, bright living-dining room with a fireplace, sliding doors opening onto a generous private terrace of around 35m², an independent fitted kitchen, and a guest toilet.

The top floor is entirely given over to the master suite: a 27m² bedroom with a large wardrobe, renovated en-suite bathroom with walk-in shower, and direct access to a private balcony with open views of the residential area and the mountains beyond.

Completely ready to move into.
features: 5 min to Rio Real Golf by car

title: Monte Salma
shortDescription: South-facing penthouse overlooking Río Real Golf and the Mediterranean, with an exceptional 116 m² rooftop solarium and open sea and golf views.
description:
A beautifully positioned two-bedroom penthouse overlooking Rio Real Golf and the Mediterranean, with an exceptional rooftop solarium and the opportunity to make it entirely your own.

South-facing and generously proportioned, the living room offers approximately 40 m² of space with marble flooring and an open outlook towards the golf course and Mediterranean beyond. The apartment has been well maintained over the years, with improvements to the bathrooms, appliances and air conditioning system — a home you could comfortably enjoy as it stands, with considerable scope for someone looking to introduce a more contemporary interior.

The independent kitchen is fully furnished and equipped. Two generously sized bedrooms both benefit from built-in wardrobes and the south-facing orientation that fills the apartment with natural light.

At approximately 116 m², the rooftop solarium is almost as large as the apartment itself. Accessed directly from the private terrace, it enjoys open views across Rio Real Golf towards the Mediterranean, with the mountains forming a backdrop to the surrounding landscape. Part of the solarium has been transformed into a comfortable lounge beneath a wooden-beamed structure with double-insulated PVC glazing and awnings — a space designed to be enjoyed throughout the year.

Note: The solarium is community-owned but designated for the exclusive use of this penthouse. Buyers should review the relevant community documentation to confirm the precise terms of use.

The penthouse is situated within an established residential development dating from 1993, surrounded by mature communal gardens. Residents enjoy a shared swimming pool, lift access, an included parking space and storage room.

Rio Real Golf, the beach (around 20 minutes on foot or 3 minutes by car) and Marbella town centre are all within easy reach.

title: La Finca de Marbella
shortDescription: A striking modern villa in the prestigious Río Real 'La Finca de Marbella' community — private pool, tropical garden, and spectacular mountain and sea views.
description:
This luxurious modern villa is located in the residential community of Río Real 'La Finca de Marbella', 15 minutes walk from the beach, 5 minutes by car from the centre of Marbella and 15 minutes from Puerto Banús.

The three-bedroom villa is arranged over two levels: two bedrooms on the upper floor each with a large terrace and spectacular mountain, city and partial sea views; and one bedroom on the ground floor. Each room is equipped with elegant furniture and a private bathroom.

The ground floor features a kitchenette and floor-to-ceiling windows that dissolve the boundary between interior and exterior — making the space especially light and pleasant. Outside, a 32m² heated pool with outdoor shower and heat pump sits within a beautifully planted tropical garden. Private parking for two cars is enclosed within the plot.

Underfloor heating, air conditioning, alarm system and cameras throughout.
features: Upper terrace with sea & mountain views
